# Noah Charnow

> Creative director in San Diego. Fifteen years of brand work, five of them leading creative at Google Devices and Services after the Fitbit acquisition. Co-founder of Loose Cannon Co., a social-first creative agency.

Noah Charnow works across brand identity, campaign, packaging, retail and design systems. Clients and employers include Google, Fitbit, Huckberry, Heath Ceramics, Chrome Industries and Sol Republic.

## Work

- [Google x McLaren](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/mclaren-case-study.html): Google x McLaren. 24 hours, zero brief, Lando Norris and a race car.
- [Fitbit brand systems inside Google](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/fitbit-case-study.html): Fitbit brand systems inside Google. Design system for 128M+ users.
- [Huckberry seasonal campaigns](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/huckberry-case-study.html): Huckberry seasonal campaigns. Record-breaking Cyber Monday.
- [Google New Store Playbook](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/google-playbook-case-study.html): Google New Store Playbook. Retail system for global store openings.
- [Heath Ceramics](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/heath-ceramics-case-study.html): Heath Ceramics. In-house design lead for the California pottery.
- [Stonewall Powered by Google](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/stonewall-case-study.html): Stonewall Powered by Google. NYC billboard and retail installation.
- [Google Pride 2024](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/pride-2024-case-study.html): Google Pride 2024. Floral retail identity across Google Store.
- [Chrome Industries](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/chrome-industries-case-study.html): Chrome Industries. Twelve campaigns a year across every channel.
- [Low Bar](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/lowbar-case-study.html): Low Bar. Brand identity for Oakland's upscale dive.
- [Upstate](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/upstate-case-study.html): Upstate. Huckberry sub-brand, identity through launch.
- [Wills](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/wills-case-study.html): Wills. Huckberry sub-brand, identity through launch.
- [Sol Republic](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/sol-republic-case-study.html): Sol Republic. Packaging for the Relays Sport Wireless launch.
- [Logos](https://noahcharnow-portfolio.netlify.app/logos-case-study.html): Logos. Nine marks for restaurants, bars, sub-brands and monograms.
